representations.sbert: 768-d all-mpnet-base-v2 sentence embedding (256-token window) -> MLP 768-256-32-1, dropout 0.2
representations.bertmean: masked mean of BERT tokens (128-token window) -> same MLP
representations.combined: early fusion: 3-layer token CNN 768-256-128-64 (masked max pool, 64-d) concat SBERT 768-d -> MLP 832-64-32-1

epochs.selection: 5-fold CV on the source pool; final epochs = mean of fold best epochs

target_transform: raw story points (same as 05, for the paired comparison)

extended_metrics.SA_seed_rule: 42*1000 + pair index (same draws for every method)
extended_metrics.a12: Vargha-Delaney vs median-baseline errors on the same issues
